title: United States: ASME practice, third-angle projection

rules.projection: Third-angle projection (projection method 3) with its symbol in the title block.
rules.sheet: ANSI sheet sizes A (8.5 x 11 in) to E, or ISO A-series when the customer works metric. Plain sheet with an own title block: never a vendor logo.
rules.scale: Scales as 1:1, 1:2, 2:1 (or FULL, HALF); main scale in the title block.
rules.units: Units as agreed: inches with decimal point and no leading zero (.50), or millimetres with a leading zero (0.5); state the unit in the title block.
rules.general_tolerances: General tolerances in the title block by decimal places (e.g. .X +/-.1, .XX +/-.01, .XXX +/-.005, angles +/-1 deg) instead of ISO 2768.
rules.gps: GD&T per ASME Y14.5 (Rule #1 envelope applies by default); note 'INTERPRET PER ASME Y14.5-2018'.
rules.geometric_tolerances: Feature control frames per ASME Y14.5, datums A B C; tolerance functional surfaces only.
rules.surface_texture: Surface texture symbols per ASME Y14.36, values in microinches (e.g. 32) or micrometres for metric drawings.
rules.lettering: Upright single-stroke gothic capitals, 0.12 in (3 mm) for dimensions.
rules.title_block: Title block at the bottom right per ASME Y14.100: title, drawing number, revision, material, finish, scale, sheet, projection symbol, tolerance block, drawn by NXonaut, date (YYYY-MM-DD).

rules.series: Metric ISO threads for metric designs; unified threads (UNC, UNF per ASME B1.1, class 2A/2B) for inch designs, noted as '1/4-20 UNC-2B'.

rules.designation: Name materials per AISI/SAE or ASTM (AISI 1045, 4140, 6061-T6, 304).
rules.defaults: Shafts AISI 1045 or 4140; plates A36; aluminium 6061-T6; stainless 304 or 303 (machined).
